continuity: Yayul Cheok is the over-eighty Beast Miao King, lord of the Nanman Beast Palace, a Supreme Peak master among the Ten Kings, and great chieftain representing the Miao people.
The Nanman Beast Palace encompasses thirty-two tribes across Nanman, including four great tribal groups, so its Palace Lord cannot decide major matters alone.
Yayul Cheok received a delayed message about Dark Heaven more than a month ago, before the Mount Song Resolution, and understands the broad situation in the Central Plains.
The Nanman Beast Palace has not formally rejected joining the Murim Alliance, but its decision remains unresolved.
plot: The Beast Miao King, Yayul Cheok, arrives at the pasture and questions the Fire Dragon Pavilion about the fire. Jin Taekyung deflects responsibility to Namho, then withstands Yayul Cheok's punch and jokes that Jeok Cheongang described him as warmhearted and fond of pranks. Recognizing Taekyung as Jeok's Disciple, Yayul Cheok welcomes him and leads the group inside.

In the Nanman Beast Palace's main hall, Yayul Cheok recounts his violent but friendly first meeting with Jeok Cheongang and learns that Taekyung came as the Murim Alliance's Pavilion Master to address Dark Heaven. He explains that the Nanman Beast Palace has not rejected the alliance but that, as great chieftain of the Miao people, he cannot decide for the thirty-two tribes and four great tribal groups alone. Before Taekyung can ask whether Cheok supports joining, someone outside requests an audience.
translation_decisions: Use Beast Miao King for 야수묘왕, Yayul Cheok for 야율척, and Palace Lord for 궁주.
Use great chieftain for 대족장 and Miao people for 묘족.
Retain Old Master Jeok for 적 노 when Yayul Cheok refers to Jeok Cheongang.

active_continuity: The Fire Dragon Pavilion is now inside the Nanman Beast Palace's main hall under Yayul Cheok's hospitality.
Yayul Cheok is the over-eighty Beast Miao King, lord of the Nanman Beast Palace, a Supreme Peak master among the Ten Kings, and great chieftain representing the Miao people.
Yayul Cheok is an old acquaintance of Jeok Cheongang and warmly welcomes Jin Taekyung after recognizing him as Jeok's Disciple.
The Nanman Beast Palace encompasses thirty-two tribes across Nanman, including four great tribal groups, and its Palace Lord cannot decide major matters alone.
Yayul Cheok received a delayed Dark Heaven message more than a month ago, before the Mount Song Resolution, and knows the broad situation in the Central Plains.
The Nanman Beast Palace has not formally rejected joining the Murim Alliance, but its decision remains unresolved.
Jin Taekyung is representing the Murim Alliance as Pavilion Master rather than visiting Nanman solely as Jeok Cheongang's Disciple.
open_questions: Who is requesting a private audience with Yayul Cheok beyond the main hall doors?
Will the Nanman Beast Palace join the Murim Alliance after the tribal decision is made?
Are other tribes opposing membership while Yayul Cheok is personally open to it?
Was the timing of the Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau massacre connected to Dark Heaven's scheme?
temporary_decisions: Use Beast Miao King for 야수묘왕 and Yayul Cheok for 야율척.
Use Palace Lord for 궁주 and great chieftain for 대족장.
Use Old Master Jeok for 적 노 in Yayul Cheok's dialogue.

profile_creations.personality: Boisterous, warmhearted, forthright, playful, and politically conscious of the tribal coalition he leads.
profile_creations.relationships: Jeok Cheongang is an old acquaintance whom he respects; Yayul Mok serves as his Young Palace Lord; Jin Taekyung is Jeok's Disciple whom he welcomes into the Nanman Beast Palace.
profile_creations.role: Yayul Cheok is the over-eighty Beast Miao King, lord of the Nanman Beast Palace, a Supreme Peak master among the Ten Kings, and great chieftain representing the Miao people.
profile_creations.voice: Rough, loud, convivial, and teasing, becoming authoritative when discussing Nanman's laws or political decisions.
